name: Saikyou Goshujin-sama! -Mighty My Master-
original_name: 最強御主人様！－Mighty My Master－
source:
Riza is a male knight. He usually lives peacefully, but he joins the army once battles break out. Astride a huge robot, he goes to the battlefield to save people again....

[Edited from ErogeShop]
translation:
莉莎是一名男性骑士。平日里，他过着安稳生活；一旦战事爆发，便会加入军队。他驾驶巨型机器人奔赴战场，再次拯救人们…
